gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
The two sides failed to reach an ___ (AGREE).
He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
The soup is a ___ (MIX) of herbs and spices.
gaps.explanation: 'A mixture of' — the noun for a blend.

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: She waited ___ (ANXIOUS) by the phone for news.
The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.
